children: SRX Global entered into a Limited Consent and Amendment Agreement with the Required Holders of its Series C Preferred to permit a stock repurchase plan. The plan allows the company to buy back up to the lesser of 10,000,000 shares or 50% of outstanding common shares, capped at $20 million, through July 7, 2027. The consent aligns the buyback program with terms under the previously disclosed Series C financing and enhances capital allocation flexibility.
: Limited Consent and Amendment Agreement for stock repurchase plan
: Required Holders of Series C Preferred
: Enable structured share repurchases under financing covenants
